title: Orchestrator with Delegate and Finish
overview: Build the central Orchestrator class that never executes environment actions directly. It has exactly two system actions: Delegate(Phi) which spawns a sub-agent from a 4-tuple and collects its observation, and Finish(y) which terminates with a final answer. The orchestrator maintains a state history of all delegations and observations. It uses an LLM to decide at each step whether to Delegate (and with what tuple) or Finish.

problem_statement: Need a central orchestrator that decomposes complex tasks into subtasks and delegates to dynamically-created sub-agents.
motivation: The orchestrator is the brain of AOrchestra - it decides what to do and who does it.
